data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘kenos’, meaning ‘empty’ or ‘void’. In early Christian tradition, the name Kenon was given to boys representing new life and spiritual renewal. The name Kenon carries the meaning “Youth, young boy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kenon usually hope their child will grow to embody youth, young boy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of spiritual emptiness, openness, and receptivity.
data.etymology: Kenon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youth, young boy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kenon total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
